newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Jan-Aug real wages drop 4.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Jan-Aug real wages drop 4.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Monthly real wages at Hungary's non-agricultural enterprises were 4.5 percent lower in the January-August period than in the same period of last year, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Wednesday.
Real wages in the first seven months of this year were 4.7 percent down from the January-July period of 1995.
The average monthly net wage in the first eight months of 1996 was 30,274 forints, up 19.5 percent from the same period of last year, the KSH said.
Inflation from the first eight months of 1995 over the corresponding period of this year was 25.1 percent, it added.
